remaining_gap: Citation attribution does not address authorization-conditioned answerability.

remaining_gap: Validation-centered RAG is very close architecturally, but the reported study does not center authorized-only evidence sufficiency and unauthorized-only answer availability.
verification_notes: CiteGuard-RAG integrates hybrid retrieval, citation-constrained generation, sentence-level grounding validation, regeneration, refusal and controlled/external evaluation.

title: Authorization-First Retrieval: Enforcing Least Privilege in Multi-Agent RAG Systems

remaining_gap: Permission-aware retrieval is established, but evidence sufficiency and refusal under authorized/unauthorized evidence mixtures are not the primary construct.

title: Privacy-provisioned-permission-aware RAG in cloud using identity and access management, trust and large-language models
remaining_gap: Adds privacy-preserving IAM and trust mechanisms but does not center authorized-evidence sufficiency and abstention behavior.
